recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied Jira decision by correcting the only discovered semantic mismatch; no broader DeviceRequest as-needed constraint or wording change was made because the approved motion only specified the two elements and their cardinalities.
issue_request: FHIR-37700 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by OO. It asked DeviceRequest to support PRN requests by adding DeviceRequest.asNeeded as a 0..1 boolean and DeviceRequest.asNeededFor as a 0..* CodeableConcept reason, matching the ServiceRequest/Dosage as-needed pattern.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was added to the build with PR commit d52faf4. In this repository history, 29c23bb9a0fc168dcbbf8051cc783148e88d6486 added DeviceRequest.asNeeded and DeviceRequest.asNeededFor, but implemented DeviceRequest.asNeededFor with max 1 instead of the approved 0..* cardinality.
additional_context: DeviceRequest is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini records DeviceRequest.asNeeded and DeviceRequest.asNeededFor as added elements. The OO 2022-07-18 HCP minutes repeat the approved 0..* cardinality for DeviceRequest.asNeededFor. ServiceRequest.asNeededFor, the pattern referenced by the Jira, is 0..* in current source. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml so DeviceRequest.asNeededFor has max "*" and updated source/devicerequest/devicerequest.svg so the checked-in resource diagram displays 0..* instead of the stale 0..1.
source_changes: source/devicerequest/devicerequest.svg: changed the displayed DeviceRequest.asNeededFor cardinality from [0..1] to [0..*].
